description.en: Trims tool results before they enter the model context: structural summaries for JSON-shaped tool output, head/tail caps for long text, repeat deltas for identical calls, and an artifact spill with a guard_query tool that searches the original. The original is always written to disk and any failure passes the result through untouched. Ships a context index and a Savings view tab showing the net bill estimate (gross minus suspected rework) together with measured usage from dsh-context-kit when present.
description.zh: 在工具结果进入模型上下文之前做确定性治理：JSON 结果转结构摘要、长文本头尾截断、重复调用只发差异、原文落盘并可用 guard_query 检索；任何异常都原样放行，图片/多块结果不改写。附带上下文索引和「节省」视图标签，显示净账单估算（毛节省 − 疑似返工），装了 dsh-context-kit 时还会读它的实测用量。
